summary: You commit with everything or not at all.
body: You commit with everything or not at all. Your Sun conjunct Moon means your head and your heart move as one, so when you want something, all of you wants it. The blind spot? When every part of you agrees, no one's left to ask the hard questions. Keep honest people close. Let them push back.
gift: Clear inner alignment, wholehearted commitment, and the ability to move without splitting yourself in two.
shadow: Certainty can arrive so quickly that no inner voice slows down to ask what else needs to be considered.
integration: Let trusted people ask the questions that your own inner agreement may skip.
do: Notice when all of you says yes at once
Invite a trusted outside perspective before major commitments
Let conviction stay open to better information
dont: Treat inner agreement as proof that every detail has been checked
